subject: Fiscal Year 2026 Preliminary Departmental Budget Hearings
overview: The Committee of the Whole conducted its second preliminary budget meeting for fiscal year 2026, reviewing requests from four city departments. Officials focused on contractual personnel increases, operational efficiencies, and departmental revenue projections.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2026 Preliminary Budget Process
items.summary: The Council opened the second of several preliminary budget meetings to review departmental requests ahead of the Mayor's formal budget submission.

items.title: Collector-Treasurer Department
items.summary: The Treasurer presented a $780,059 budget request, which includes a $22,565 increase for contractual raises and professional certification expenses.

items.title: Medford Community Media
items.summary: The Station Manager outlined a $215,061 budget increase driven by personnel costs and legal fees required for upcoming cable license renegotiations.

items.title: Parking Department
items.summary: The committee requested data on revenue and outstanding citations while reviewing a $1,074,840 budget that includes increased vendor fees for parking technology.

items.title: Veterans Services
items.summary: The Director reported on a $448,716 budget, highlighting recent zero-cost office accessibility improvements and plans to digitize department files.
